data.title: Prediction: Wall Street May Be Sleeping on This AI Cloud Giant
data.description: Micron has surged over 250% this year on an AI memory boom, but our price target sits below where shares trade today while Wall Street analysts aim far higher. The gap between those two views reveals a fundamental disagreement about whether this cycle is different from every one that came before it.
